teaser: A brief to give every email agent its own key, vouched for by its person, so each email carries a QR code that proves it is authentic.
core_idea: Now that agents draft our email, each email agent should have its own key, vouched for by its person on pki.sgit.ai with a delegation that can expire or be withdrawn; every draft is signed and carries a link and a QR code to a page that checks, in the browser, who signed it, for whom, whether the delegation holds and whether the email changed, which DKIM, S/MIME and PGP do not give an ordinary reader; with one official email agent per person, anything sent on our behalf can be proved.
